trans-unit.source:
This app allows you to interface your Docebo e-learning platform with your WordPress installation. Thanks to this integration, you can import in Docebo your Wordpress users and enable the SSO (Single Sign On) between the two applications. You can also enable a Wordpress block to easily show to users the courses they are enrolled in within the Docebo platform.
In order to enable the plug-in you need to add it from your WordPress administration area, or you can download it from Docebo.com.
trans-unit.target:
This app allows you to interface your Docebo e-learning platform with your WordPress installation. Thanks to this integration, you can import in Docebo your Wordpress users and enable the SSO (Single Sign On) between the two applications. You can also enable a Wordpress block to easily show to users the courses they are enrolled in within the Docebo platform.
In order to enable the plug-in you need to add it from your WordPress administration area, or you can download it from Docebo.com.

trans-unit.source: Selling your online courses has never been that easy, thanks to the capabilities of our dedicated E-commerce app. Right after activating it, you will be able to market your courses, via your own custom catalog of courses. Your customers will be able to browse through your course catalog, and simply pay for each course via credit card. You will be collecting 100% of your net sales price directly in your PayPal for Business account.
trans-unit.target: Zure lineako ikastaroak saltzea ez da inoiz hain erraza izan, gure merkataritza elektronikoko aplikazio dedikatuaren gaitasunei esker. Aktibatu eta berehala, zure ikastaroak merkaturatu ahal izango dituzu, zure ikastaroen katalogo pertsonalizatuaren bidez. Zure bezeroek zure ikastaroen katalogoan arakatu ahal izango dute, eta ikastaro bakoitza kreditu-txartelaren bidez ordaindu besterik ez dute. Zure salmenten prezio garbiaren %100 zuzenean jasoko duzu PayPal for Business kontuan.

trans-unit.id: Bamboo HR solves that by keeping the information in an interactive database that can integrate into other programs. It updates across the board when information is changed so that everything is current all the time.
trans-unit.source: BambooHR solves that by keeping the information in an interactive database that can integrate into other programs. It updates across the board when information is changed so that everything is current all the time.
trans-unit.target: BambooHR-k informazioa beste programa batzuetan integra daitekeen datu-base interaktibo batean gordeta konpontzen du. Informazioa aldatzen denean informazio guztia eguneratzen da, dena uneoro egon dadin.

trans-unit.id: BambooHR is an HR software solution, not an outsourcing provider. While we don't provide HR staff for you, we do offer top-notch tools that help time-strapped HR professionals perform the work of many.

trans-unit.target: BambooHR HR software irtenbide bat da, ez azpikontratazio hornitzaile bat. HR langilerik eskaintzen ez dizugu arren, denbora gutxi duten HR profesionalei askoren lana egiten laguntzen dieten goi mailako tresnak eskaintzen ditugu.

trans-unit.id:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is the trusted provider of on-demand elearning courses for enterprise companies. These organizations depend on OpenSesame to train millions of employees with an entirely new and better way—easier, more economical, with less risk—to access the best on-­demand training. With the world's largest library of 20,000+ business, safety, technology, and compliance courses
trans-unit.source: <h2>About OpenSesame</h2><p>OpenSesame is the trusted provider of on-demand e-learning courses for enterprise companies. These organizations depend on OpenSesame to train millions of employees with an entirely new and better way—easier, more economical, with less risk—to access the best on-­demand training. With the world's largest library of 20,000+ business, safety, technology, and compliance courses</p>
trans-unit.target: <h2>OpenSesameri buruz</h2><p>OpenSesame enpresa-enpresentzako eskaera elektronikoko ikaskuntza-ikastaroen hornitzaile fidagarria da. Erakunde hauek OpenSesameren menpe daude milioika langile trebatzeko modu guztiz berri eta hobe batekin -errazagoa, ekonomikoagoa, arrisku gutxiagorekin- eskatutako prestakuntza onena eskuratzeko. 20.000+ negozio, segurtasun, teknologia eta betetze ikastaroko munduko liburutegirik handienarekin</p>

trans-unit.id:
OpenSesame delivers:

- Easy searching, deployment, and administration of courses through integration with Docebo


- The most flexible buying options to maximize your budget and to simplify procurement


- The broadest, freshest, deepest curated catalog from the world’s leading publishers to meet the needs of your training programs and objectives
trans-unit.source: <h2>OpenSesame delivers:</h2><p>- Easy searching, deployment, and administration of courses through integration with Docebo</p><br/><p>- The most flexible buying options to maximize your budget and to simplify procurement</p><br/><p>- The broadest, freshest, deepest curated catalog from the world’s leading publishers to meet the needs of your training programs and objectives</p>
trans-unit.target: <h2>OpenSesame-k eskaintzen du:</h2><p>- Docebo-rekin integratuta ikastaroak bilatzeko, hedatzeko eta administratzeko errazak</p><br><p>- Erosketa aukera malguenak zure aurrekontua maximizatzeko eta sinplifikatzeko. kontratazioa</p><br><p>- Munduko argitaletxe nagusien komisario-katalogorik zabalena, freskoena eta sakonena zure prestakuntza-programen eta helburuen beharrei erantzuteko</p>

trans-unit.source: Your category will be placed as shown below:

trans-unit.source: Learn business, creative, and technology skills to achieve your personal and professional goals. Join today to get access to thousands of courses
trans-unit.target: Ikasi negozio, sormen eta teknologia trebetasunak zure helburu pertsonalak eta profesionalak lortzeko. Erregistratu gaur milaka ikastarotara sartzeko

trans-unit.source: LinkedIn Learning combines the industry-leading content from Lynda.com with LinkedIn’s professional data and network. With more than 450 million member profiles and billions of engagements, we have a unique view of how jobs, industries, organizations and skills evolve over time. From this, we can identify the skills you need and deliver expert-led courses to help you obtain those skills. We’re taking the guesswork out of learning.
trans-unit.target: LinkedIn Learning-ek Lynda.com-en sektoreko liderra den edukia LinkedIn-ren datu profesionalekin eta sarearekin konbinatzen du. 450 milioi kide profil baino gehiagorekin eta milaka milioi konpromisorekin, denboran zehar lanpostuak, industriak, erakundeak eta trebetasunak nola eboluzionatzen duten ikuspegi paregabea dugu. Hortik, behar dituzun gaitasunak identifikatu ditzakegu eta adituek gidatutako ikastaroak eman ditzakegu trebetasun horiek lortzen laguntzeko. Ikastetik asmakizunak kentzen ari gara.

trans-unit.source: World-class content. Our library of 9,000+ digital courses are taught by industry experts and cover a wide range of business, creative and technical topics.
trans-unit.target: Mundu mailako edukiak. 9.000 ikastaro digital baino gehiagoko gure liburutegia industriako adituek ematen dute eta negozio, sormen eta gai tekniko ugari biltzen dituzte.

trans-unit.source: Data-driven personalization. We get the right course in front of you at the right time. Using the intelligence that comes with our network.
trans-unit.target: Datuetan oinarritutako pertsonalizazioa. Ikastaro egokia zure aurrean une egokian jasotzen dugu. Gure sarearekin datorren adimena erabiliz.

trans-unit.source: Anytime, anywhere convenience. It isn’t enough to know exactly which course to take – it also needs to be easy to take. Our courses are broken into bite-sized segments that can be viewed anytime, on any device, online and off.
trans-unit.target: Edonoiz, edonon erosotasuna. Ez da nahikoa zein ikastaro egin behar den jakitea; gainera, erraza izan behar da. Gure ikastaroak zati txikietan banatuta daude, edonoiz eta edozein gailutan ikus daitezkeenak, linean zein kanpoan.

trans-unit.source: Lynda.com leading online learning platform that helps anyone learn business, software, technology and creative skills to achieve personal and professional goals. Through individual, corporate, academic and government subscriptions, members have access to the lynda.com video library of engaging, top-quality courses taught by recognized industry experts.
trans-unit.target: Lynda.com lineako ikaskuntza-plataforma liderra, edonori negozioa, softwarea, teknologia eta sormen gaitasunak ikasten laguntzen diona helburu pertsonalak eta profesionalak lortzeko. Norbanakoen, korporazioen, akademikoen eta gobernuaren harpidetzei esker, kideek lynda.com bideo-liburutegira sarbidea dute industriako aditu ospetsuek ematen dituzten kalitate goreneko ikastaro erakargarriez.

trans-unit.source: For 20 years, lynda.com has helped learners, leaders, IT and design pros, project managers build software, creative and business skills. Now part of LinkedIn, Lynda.com serves more than 10,000 organizations. With tutorials in five languages, Lynda.com is a global platform for success.
trans-unit.target: 20 urtez, lynda.com-ek ikasleei, liderrei, IT eta diseinuko profesionalei, proiektu-kudeatzaileei software, sormen eta negozio trebetasunak eraikitzen lagundu die. Orain LinkedIn-en parte da, Lynda.com-ek 10.000 erakunde baino gehiagori ematen die zerbitzua. Bost hizkuntzatako tutoretzak dituena, Lynda.com arrakastarako plataforma globala da.

trans-unit.source: - Unlimited access: Choose exactly what you'd like to learn from our extensive subscription library.
trans-unit.target: - Sarbide mugagabea: aukeratu zer ikasi nahi duzun gure harpidetza liburutegi zabaletik.

trans-unit.source: - Expert teachers: Learn from industry experts who are passionate about teaching.
trans-unit.target: - Irakasle adituak: irakaskuntzarako grina duten sektoreko adituengandik ikasi.

trans-unit.source: - Learn anywhere: Switch between your devices without loosing your place.
trans-unit.target: - Ikasi edonon: aldatu zure gailu batetik bestera lekua galdu gabe.

trans-unit.source: - Learning paths: Industry experts teach you the knowledge and skills to start your career.
trans-unit.target: - Ikasteko bideak: industriako adituek zure karrera hasteko ezagutzak eta trebetasunak irakasten dizkizute.

trans-unit.source: Skilla designs its multimedia courses to promote self-directed learning and to make everyone in every organisation fall in love with digital learning. Skilla is an Italian eLearning company, its customers include prestigious Italian brands and companies. Skilla won the award of Excellence of the Year in the Education Sector at The Le Fonti Awards in London.
trans-unit.target: Skilla-k bere multimedia ikastaroak diseinatzen ditu norberak zuzendutako ikaskuntza sustatzeko eta erakunde guztietan ikaskuntza digitalaz maitemintzeko. Skilla Italiako eLearning enpresa bat da, bere bezeroen artean italiar marka eta enpresa ospetsuak daude. Skillak Hezkuntza Sektoreko Urteko Bikaintasunaren saria irabazi zuen Londresko Le Fonti sarietan.

trans-unit.source: The library of Skilla includes content on communication skills, leadership skills, project management skills, digital skill, “train the trainer”, etc. Its 250 microlearning courses (in English and Italian) are a rich and evolving library, the perfect solution for any company wishing to enhance its platform with brief and engaging learning content.
trans-unit.target: Skilla-ren liburutegiak komunikazio-gaitasunei, lidergo-gaitasunak, proiektuak kudeatzeko trebetasunak, trebetasun digitalak, "trebatzailea prestatzea" eta abar biltzen ditu. Bere 250 mikroikaskuntza-ikastaroak (ingelesez eta italieraz) liburutegi aberats eta ebolutibo bat dira, bere plataforma ikasteko eduki labur eta erakargarriekin hobetu nahi duen edozein enpresarentzat irtenbide ezin hobea.

trans-unit.source: - bite-sized lessons – Lack of time for learning? The good news is that every single module is short and stand-alone. The modules are not simple videos, reading, interactive animation, self-evaluation, etc. Everything is agile and created with an appealing look and feel
trans-unit.target: - bite-sized lessons - Lack of time for learning? The good news is that every single module is short and stand-alone. The modules are not simple videos, reading, interactive animation, self-evaluation, etc. Everything is agile and created with an appealing look and feel

trans-unit.source: - Open library and more – The 250 microlearning courses will be great - 1) as an engaging open library for your employees; 2) to support specific HR processes (e.g.: modules for the performance management process); 3) to create your own customised learning path (e.g.: for new hires and new managers, to train the trainer, etc.); 4) to improve your face-to- face training, using the modules in the Skilla library before or after an “offline” session;
trans-unit.target: - Liburutegi irekia eta gehiago - 250 mikroikaskuntza ikastaroak bikainak izango dira - 1) zure langileentzako liburutegi ireki erakargarri gisa; 2) HR prozesu zehatzei laguntzeko (adibidez: errendimendua kudeatzeko prozesurako moduluak); 3) norberaren ikasketa-ibilbide pertsonalizatua sortzeko (adibidez: kontratazio berrientzat eta zuzendari berrientzat, prestatzailea prestatzeko, etab.); 4) zure prestakuntza presentziala hobetzeko, Skilla liburutegiko moduluak “offline" saio baten aurretik edo ondoren erabiliz;

trans-unit.source: - Technology – The user interface is perfect for tablets and desktops. An Adobe Flash version can be used by older browsers, although any device (desktop or mobile) without Adobe Flash installed will be able to open automatically the html5 versions;
trans-unit.target: - Teknologia - Erabiltzailearen interfazea ezin hobea da tabletetarako eta mahaigainetarako. Adobe Flash bertsioa nabigatzaile zaharragoek erabil dezakete, nahiz eta Adobe Flash instalatuta ez duen edozein gailu (mahaigaineko edo mugikor) automatikoki ireki ahal izango dituen html5 bertsioak;

trans-unit.source: - Pricing – There is an annual fee for unlimited users. You can choose certain specific content (e.g.: content solely on digital skills or team working) or the entire Library. You will have an asset that allows multiple combinations.
trans-unit.target: - Pricing - There is an annual fee for unlimited users. You can choose certain specific content (e.g.: content solely on digital skills or team working) or the entire Library. You will have an asset that allows multiple combinations.

By migrating the custom reports from the old Reports menu to the New Reports menu, you'll be able to view and edit your reports using the new features available for the New Custom Reports. - Properties
- Visibility
- Filters
- Report fields

But the schedules configured for the report won't be migrated.

By migrating the custom reports from the old Reports menu to the New Reports menu, you'll be able to view and edit your reports using the new features available for the New Custom Reports. Only the reports created after January 1, 2019 will be migrated. Please note that when migrating a scheduled report, the report will be migrated, but without its schedules.

trans-unit.source: Insert the MySQL SELECT query in the area below. You will be able to use dynamic filters by adding an SQL condition with a runtime parameter. The parameter that will be substituted with the runtime value can be added by adding ":" at the beginning of the string (for example: SELECT idts from core_user where valid = :valid). The query will need to have all of the columns specified (a SELECT* query will not be parsed) to be considered correct. If an alias is used, it will appear in the column name for the field step of the wizard. It is mandatory to use aliases when using table names, table aliases, functions or sub-selects in the SELECT clause.
trans-unit.target: Txertatu MySQL SELECT kontsulta beheko eremuan. Iragazki dinamikoak erabili ahal izango dituzu SQL baldintza bat exekutatzeko parametro batekin gehituz. Exekutatzeko balioarekin ordezkatuko den parametroa gehi daiteke ":" katearen hasieran (adibidez: SELECT idts from core_user where valid = :valid). Kontsultak zutabe guztiak zehaztuta izan beharko ditu (HAUSTU* kontsulta bat ez da analizatuko) zuzena izateko. trans-unit.id: SECURITY WARNING: This widget allows you to add any page to your site. When providing a URL, there’s no way for your LMS to check the content within that URL. Remember that any user with editing permissions for this widget can add any valid URL into the iFrame. trans-unit.source: SECURITY WARNING: This widget allows you to add any page to your site. When providing a URL, there’s no way for your platform to check the content within that URL. Remember that any user with editing permissions for this widget can add any valid URL into the iframe. Consequently, it’s YOUR responsibility to ensure that no one includes malicious pages, including: pages containing trojans, backdoors, viruses, pages that break out of the iframe, phishing or fake sites, or pages showing illegal content.
trans-unit.target: SEGURTASUN OHARRA: widget honek zure webgunean edozein orrialde gehitzeko aukera ematen dizu. URL bat ematean, zure plataformak ez du modurik URL horren edukia egiaztatzeko. Gogoratu widget hau editatzeko baimenak dituen edozein erabiltzailek baliozko edozein URL gehi dezakeela iframe-ra. Ondorioz, ZURE erantzukizuna da inork ez dituela orri gaiztorik sartzen ziurtatzea, besteak beste: troiarrak, atzeko ateak, birusak, iframe-tik irteten diren orriak, phishing edo faltsuak diren guneak edo legez kanpoko edukia erakusten duten orrialdeak.
